facts.fact: Internet Society Pulse, from PeeringDB data last updated January 2026, lists BENIN-IX in Cotonou with 4 member networks (ISOCEL SA, SBIN, PCH AS3856, PCH AS42), 12 Gbps cumulative port capacity and 1 of 4 members peering at the route server.

Internet Society Pulse (PeeringDB, January 2026) shows BENIN-IX in Cotonou with 2 of its 4 members registered in the United States (PCH AS3856 and PCH AS42) and 2 in Benin, so networks from another country are members at an exchange in Benin.
